method: app.Registry with non-nil monitor and command-denying Executor; no tools executed

tools.name: dependencies_install
tools.title: Install module dependencies
tools.description: Install native dependencies for an optional module. Does not add repositories or change container ownership, group memberships, or daemon startup settings. Native package scripts can start services; on Arch also upgrades the system. Restart Maestro after installation to refresh provider discovery.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.title: Cancel job
tools.description: Request cancellation of a running management job. Completed host changes cannot be undone by cancellation.

tools.name: jobs_get
tools.title: Job details
tools.description: Read a management job's state, result, and bounded output.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.title: Recent jobs
tools.description: List up to 64 recent management jobs, newest first. Fetch an individual job for output.

tools.name: managed_apply_retry
tools.title: Retry configuration apply
tools.description: Inspect incomplete application and retry non-destructive publication as a job. Uncertain interrupted removals require explicit inspection and are not replayed.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

tools.name: managed_apply_status
tools.title: Inspect apply progress
tools.description: Read durable per-resource application status without retrying or starting resources.

tools.name: managed_artifact_reconcile
tools.title: Preserve and reconcile generated-artifact metadata
tools.description: After a separate review, preserve any existing private conflicting publication sidecar and atomically restore only its canonical metadata. Never overwrites native generated definitions, changes workloads or automatically retries apply. Requires revision, resource and exact on-disk review token.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

resource.description: Failed managed service resource, e.g. service/example

reviewToken.description: Token from the most recent artifact review

tools.name: managed_artifact_review
tools.title: Review generated artifact conflict
tools.description: Inspect the current failed publication, exact previous/desired native bytes and private sidecar state without exposing generated file contents or paths. Unsafe or drifted native files cannot be reconciled automatically.

resource.description: Failed managed service resource, e.g. service/example

tools.name: managed_backup_inventory
tools.title: Review backup inputs
tools.description: Inventory private configuration, data, image/private-file references and native/external requirements. Metadata only: never reads referenced private files, exposes native configuration contents, copies data, exports guests or produces a completed backup.

tools.name: managed_backup_prepare
tools.title: Capture backup inputs
tools.description: Capture supported stopped-workload inputs into a private checksummed bundle for a reviewed revision. This initial capture is not a prepared/restorable backup: complete filesystem metadata, advanced VM state and restore validation remain unfinished; initial stopped Incus exports and basic libvirt XML/standalone-disk collection are supported. Unresolved prerequisites block capture. Recovery of previously running workloads is attempted and failures are reported.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

destination.description: Absolute path to backup destination directory

quiesce.description: Gracefully stop running workloads during backup and resume afterward

tools.name: managed_backup_publish
tools.title: Verify and finish capture publication
tools.description: Verify the reviewed recorded capture tree and complete its durable publication. A destination must be absent or already be the recorded capture directory. Never replaces/deletes data, starts workloads, imports native data or marks the capture restorable. Requires the current configuration revision and recovery token.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

revision.description: Current configuration revision from recovery status

tools.name: managed_backup_recover
tools.title: Resume interrupted backup workloads
tools.description: Explicitly recover only previously running workloads whose stop was attempted during the reviewed capture. Rechecks configuration revision, definitions and runtime state; never replays capture or restores data.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

tools.name: managed_backup_recovery_status
tools.title: Review backup recovery
tools.description: Read the private durable record of workload stop/resume progress and staged/synced/uncertain capture publication. Does not activate workloads.

tools.name: managed_backup_release
tools.title: Leave backup workloads as they are
tools.description: Acknowledge the reviewed interrupted capture and release its management blocker without starting/stopping workloads, publishing/deleting capture data or replaying capture. Requires the current configuration revision and recovery token; retained journal states do not claim successful resumption.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

revision.description: Current configuration revision from recovery status

tools.name: managed_config_check
tools.title: Recheck configuration readiness
tools.description: Refresh native prerequisites and file/mount checks. Never installs packages or creates missing data.

tools.name: managed_config_health
tools.title: Check workload configuration
tools.description: Check configuration validity and required files without changing the host. Runtime readiness checks are reported separately.

tools.name: managed_config_history
tools.title: Configuration history
tools.description: List bounded private configuration revisions. Never reads referenced secret files. Disabled with management writes.

tools.name: managed_config_history_read
tools.title: Inspect configuration revision
tools.description: Read a verified private historical configuration, including malformed YAML for recovery. Never reads referenced secret files.

target.description: History revision to inspect or restore

tools.name: managed_config_model
tools.title: Configuration form data
tools.description: Read typed private desired definitions for editing. Disabled with management writes; never reads referenced secret files.

tools.name: managed_config_plan
tools.title: Preview configuration changes
tools.description: Validate and preview affected resources without publishing or starting workloads. Backend availability is returned explicitly.

tools.name: managed_config_read
tools.title: Inspect workload configuration
tools.description: Read private desired configuration for editing; disabled with management writes. Secret file contents are never read.

tools.name: managed_config_readiness
tools.title: Configuration readiness
tools.description: Read cached backend prerequisites and fresh file/mount checks without inspecting running workloads or changing host state. Missing or invalid configurations remain inspectable.

tools.name: managed_config_revert
tools.title: Revert configuration
tools.description: Restore a verified historical definition as a new revision and reconcile owned resources. May interrupt running workloads. Preserves data; unresolved prior removals cannot be abandoned.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

mode.description: Apply now or publish for next start

target.description: History revision to inspect or restore

tools.name: managed_config_revert_plan
tools.title: Review configuration revert
tools.description: Validate a historical definition and preview affected resources. Reverting configuration does not restore data or reverse client effects.

target.description: History revision to inspect or restore

tools.name: managed_config_save
tools.title: Save and apply configuration
tools.description: Persist authoritative configuration and apply affected native definitions as a tracked job. Failed apply retains desired configuration and reports failure; no data is deleted implicitly.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

mode.description: Apply now or publish changes for next start

tools.name: managed_config_validate
tools.title: Validate workload configuration
tools.description: Validate a proposed YAML workload configuration without saving it or activating resources.

tools.name: managed_directory_browse
tools.title: Browse directories
tools.description: List accessible directory paths for choosing a share or storage path without showing file contents.

tools.name: managed_resource_plan
tools.title: Review definition change
tools.description: Validate a typed definition edit and calculate affected resources before saving. Does not modify configuration or workloads.

definition.description: Typed definition as JSON; omitted for removal

revision.description: Current central configuration revision or missing

tools.name: managed_resource_save
tools.title: Save definition change
tools.description: Save a revision-checked typed definition through the authoritative apply workflow. Removing definitions retains persistent data where supported; unsafe removals fail explicitly.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

definition.description: Typed definition as JSON; omitted for removal

mode.description: Apply now or publish for next start

revision.description: Current central configuration revision or missing

tools.title: Managed applications
tools.description: Read configuration health and selected runtime status without secret values or backend mutations.

tools.name: managed_share_publish
tools.title: Publish or unpublish share
tools.description: Persist the share's publication toggle and apply the authoritative protocol set. Does not change shared data, accounts or host daemon enablement.

tools.name: managed_shares

tools.description: Read authoritative share definitions and protocol publication state without changing host daemons.

tools.name: managed_storage_create
tools.title: Provision new storage
tools.description: Create a reviewed empty directory or new sparse raw/qcow2 disk, optionally cloned from its configured image as a job. Never overwrites data, restores backups, creates parents, changes ownership or starts workloads.

purpose.description: Explicitly authorize new data, never replacement of missing restored data

reviewToken.description: Token from the reviewed provisioning plan

sizeGiB.description: New disk capacity in GiB; omit or use zero for a directory

tools.title: Review new storage
tools.description: Inspect an absent owned path and stopped consumers without creating data. Existing parents must be owned real directories. Private paths require management writes.

sizeGiB.description: New disk capacity in GiB; omit or use zero for a directory

tools.name: monitor_processes
tools.title: Process activity
tools.description: Read sampled process activity, sorted and filtered before limiting results. CPU uses 100% per logical core. Process command arguments and environments are never collected.

filter.description: Case insensitive process name or PID filter

sort.description: Order by CPU (default), memory, PID, or name

tools.name: monitor_snapshot
tools.title: Live resources
tools.description: Read cached Linux CPU, memory, disk, network, sensors, load and uptime with up to 60 history points. Null rates mean the first sample, a reset counter, or unavailable data. Check lastError and at for stale data.

tools.name: shares_samba_password

tools.name: shares_setup
tools.title: Set up share server
tools.description: Install native Samba/NFS server packages, prepare managed configuration, enable and start its system service. Preserves existing configuration and share data. Does not configure firewall rules or Samba passwords. On Arch, package installation also upgrades the system.

tools.name: system_capabilities
tools.title: Backend capabilities
tools.description: Read backend availability, unavailable reasons, and management write policy.

tools.name: system_status
tools.title: Server status
tools.description: Read the connected server identity and management write policy.

tools.name: updates_install
tools.title: Install system updates
tools.description: Refresh native repositories and apply normal system package updates as one serialized job. May restart services and change dependencies; no distribution migration or reboot is requested. Cancellation interrupts the native process, allowing 30 seconds before forced termination; an interrupted package transaction may need native recovery.

confirm.description: Explicit acknowledgement of this destructive operation. Must be true.

tools.name: updates_refresh
tools.title: Refresh update metadata
tools.description: Refresh package metadata as a serialized job. Arch uses checkupdates with an isolated database; requires pacman-contrib. Does not install packages or reboot.

tools.name: updates_status
tools.title: Pending system updates
tools.description: Read native package-manager capabilities, cached pending updates and reboot status where detectable. Unavailable data is explicit; this does not refresh repositories or install packages.
